messages:
Nate W: Heads-up: we hit a flakey case in the streaming sample app when token refresh races with SSE reconnects.
Priya S: Repro on which SDK?
Nate W: Node SDK (sample-app). Steps: start a long SSE stream, set token TTL to 15s so refresh fires mid-stream, auth refresh triggers reconnect and we sometimes see duplicated final tokens or out-of-order fragments.
Diego: Do you have a trimmed log?
Nate W: Log snippet:
EVENT: data: {"type":"delta","text":"Exa"}
EVENT: data: {"type":"delta","text":"mple"}
--- token refresh ---
EVENT: data: {"type":"delta","text":" payload"}
EVENT: data: [DONE]
Client seen: "Example payloadpayload" in some runs.
Priya S: Sounds like reconnect replays the tail fragment. Node parser merges on newline; maybe we're not honoring Last-Event-ID or seq.
Diego: Server-side shows the runtime emitted the same final token twice when reconnect happened during KV flush.
Nate W: Short-term: patch sample-app client to buffer partial fragments and dedupe identical final tokens.
Priya S: Agreed. Longer-term: add a small seq field to SSE events so clients can drop duplicates and reorder safely. Also add a CI e2e that forces mid-stream token expiry.
infra-bot: deploy/log: canary runtime build bld-2026-03-25-2 deployed.
Diego: Also update onboarding docs to mention token TTL and provide example hook for pre-refresh.
Nate W: I'll open a tiny PR for the node sample + a reproduction script and create an issue for seq-ids in events.
Priya S: Thanks — include a note in the PR about SDK parity (python currently swallows malformed fragments).
Nate W: Will do.
